name: The Batman
description: A young billionaire Bruce Wayne fights crime and evil as the mysterious vigilante, The Batman.

videos.overview: An analysis of the reasons for remaking Batman.

videos.title: The Batman Justice League Profiles
videos.overview: The first featurette from Season5 DVD is a discussion with the production staff as they talk about the characters of Superman, Flash, Green Lantern, Green Arrow, and Hawkman; here they discuss their takes on the individual characters and how they would work them into the show.

videos.title: Joining Forces The Batman's Legendary Team-ups
videos.overview: The second featurette from Season5 DVD continues with the first featurette's Justice League theme and this time the staff talks about the decision concerning the direction that season five took. They discuss how the show's dynamic was changed with the introduction of the Justice League to the series.

videos.overview: Explore the relationship between The Batman and his allies as he evolves from mysterious vigilante to the World's Greatest Detective

videos.overview: Highly confidential profiles of The Batman's most dastardly foes

videos.title: The Bat in the Belfry
videos.overview: Batman finds himself dealing with a new breed of criminal when Joker takes over Arkham Asylum, then plans to release a poisonous gas over Gotham City.

videos.title: Call of the Cobblepot
videos.overview: Oswald Cobblepot, the Penguin, has delusions of rebuilding the lost Cobblepot fortune with his birds that perform robberies.

videos.title: Traction
videos.overview: Batman battles the masked criminal Bane, but once Bane activates his chemical-steroid-infusion, Batman finds himself outmatched by brute strength.

videos.title: The Cat and the Bat
videos.overview: After a news report links her with Batman, Selina Kyle, aka Catwoman, designs to meet her nighttime counterpart. After drawing out her prey, Catwoman steals Batman's utility belt.

videos.title: The Man Who Would Be Bat
videos.overview: When Dr Langstrom, a scientist in Wayne's genome division, tests the experimental serum he's been devising on himself, he transforms into the hideous Man-Bat.

videos.title: The Big Chill
videos.overview: Batman is on the trail of Mr Freeze, a villain who uses ice technology as a means of stealing the objects of his passion: the rarest, most valuable diamonds.

videos.title: The Big Heat
videos.overview: Batman finds himself on the trail of Firefly, a pyromaniac supervillain, while Bruce tries to secure a charity contract with Mayor Grange.

videos.title: Q&A
videos.overview: A series of bizarre and dramatic kidnappings lead Batman into the den of the Cluemaster, a washed-up and demented ex-game show champion.

videos.title: The Big Dummy
videos.overview: Batman's attempts to thwart the latest in a series of heists finds him pitted against a team being led by a ventriloquist and a puppet called Scarface. Meanwhile, Alfred plays matchmaker for Bruce.

videos.title: Topsy Turvy
videos.overview: Batman investigates a series of revenge crimes bearing the stamp of his archenemy Joker, despite the fact that Joker is currently locked up in Arkham Asylum.

videos.title: Bird of Prey
videos.overview: Penguin breaks into Wayne Manor while Bruce is being interviewed for a TV show. Bruce must figure out a way to escape the cameras to become Batman.

videos.title: The Rubberface of Comedy (1)
videos.overview: Joker wreaks havoc on all of Gotham with a new gizmo that can morph any object into rubber or putty. Meanwhile, the Chief of Police pressures his detectives to take down The Batman once and for all.

videos.title: The Clayface of Tragedy (2)
videos.overview: Batman is pitted against a new villain named Clayface, who can transform his body as if it were clay and impersonate anyone he chooses! Before The Batman can stop him, he will learn Clayface's shocking dark secret!

videos.title: The Cat, the Bat and the Very Ugly
videos.overview: During a museum robbery, a partnership is formed between Catwoman and Penguin. But when Penguin double-crosses Catwoman before she can double-cross him, she and Batman have to stop Penguin before he unleashes his true plan: harnessing the power of Ra!

videos.title: Riddled
videos.overview: The GCPD find themselves dealing with a new threat in the form of Riddler, who has planted a bomb at Gotham's city hall. Fearing that Riddler will make good on his threat to destroy the city, Detective Yin, secretly aided by Batman, must work to solve a string of riddles that have been scattered throughout Gotham.

videos.title: Fire & Ice
videos.overview: Firefly and Mr. Freeze make an unlikely pair as they join forces to plunge Gotham into a permanent winter. With the entire police force "iced over," The Batman is the city's only hope for survival.

videos.title: The Laughing Bat
videos.overview: Joker, dressed as Batman, begins a new reign of terror in Gotham. When the real Batman tries to stop him, Joker injects him with a poison that will cause him to laugh to death, unless he can come up with an antidote.

videos.title: Swamped
videos.overview: Killer Croc, a half-man, half-reptile, plans to submerge all of Gotham under water to carry out his scheme of plundering the city.

videos.title: Pets
videos.overview: Penguin discovers a sonic device that allows him to turn Man-Bat into his personal slave. Meanwhile, Alfred must deal with a raccoon that has found its way into the Bat-Cave and is wreaking havoc on the electrical equipment.

videos.title: Meltdown
videos.overview: Despite intensive rehabilitation, Ethan Bennett once again takes the form of Clayface in order to seek revenge against Joker, the man who turned him into that monster. He's released on probation after standing trial for his crimes, but he may find the temptations of a criminal life too great.

videos.title: JTV
videos.overview: Joker pirates the airwaves of Gotham in order to broadcast his crimes on TV as entertainment. When Detective Yin's overzealous new partner tries to bring the clown prince of crime down, he merely becomes Joker's latest "co-star." Batman must find where Joker is broadcasting from before he can carry out his plan to make Gotham die of laughter!

videos.title: Ragdolls to Riches
videos.overview: Ragdoll, a triple-jointed contortionist, crosses paths with Batman and Catwoman while continuously trying to steal priceless artifacts. As a civilian, Selina Kyle befriends Bruce Wayne, but her intentions may not be so straightforward.

videos.title: The Butler Did It
videos.overview: Spellbinder, a three-eyed mystic with the ability to induce both hypnosis and visions, sets his sights on stealing the valuable Eye of Sarkana – mesmerizing Alfred to be his personal thief.

videos.title: Grundy's Night
videos.overview: Solomon Grundy, a legendary zombie, emerges from a swamp on Halloween to wreak havoc on Gotham. But Batman and Alfred discover that there is more to Grundy than there appears.

videos.title: Strange Minds
videos.overview: Joker takes Detective Yin hostage, but once captured he refuses to tell of her whereabouts. Convinced it's the only way to learn Yin's location before she meets her demise, Batman uses a device created by Professor Hugo Strange to enter the bizarre brain of the Joker in search of an answer.

videos.title: Night and the City
videos.overview: Joker, Penguin and Riddler battle over control of the City. They finally decide to settle their differences by giving all of Gotham over to whoever is able to capture and discover the true identity of the Batman.

videos.title: Batgirl Begins (1)
videos.overview: Barbara Gordon and her friend Pamela Isley lead protests against corporations for environmental damage they caused, much to Barbara's father's displeasure. But secretly, Pam is also the brains behind a string of attacks against these corporations with a powerful new super-villain named Temblor.

videos.title: Batgirl Begins (2)
videos.overview: After a chemical accident transforms her into a half-human half-plant being, Pam Isley takes the name Poison Ivy and sets out to destroy Gotham's environmental polluters. Barbara Gordon becomes Batgirl in order to save her father, the commissioner.

videos.title: A Dark Knight to Remember
videos.overview: After a physical trauma causes him to forget he's The Batman, Bruce Wayne finds himself kidnapped by the Penguin. Batgirl sets out to rescue the "helpless" amnesiac billionaire, but is captured herself.

videos.title: A Fistful of Felt
videos.overview: After his most recent crime spree, Arnold Wesker is taken to Arkham and apparently "cured" by Dr. Hugo Strange. A new career as a children's entertainer lies before Wesker, but can he escape the shadow of Scarface?

videos.title: RPM
videos.overview: Gearhead, a part-cyborg adrenaline junkie, rides into Gotham in a souped-up racer. With the ability to take control of cars using nano-technology, Gearhead is out to commit a series of crimes for thrills. Batman soon finds himself forced to upgrade the Batmobile to keep up with the cybernetic bad guy.

videos.title: Brawn
videos.overview: After getting his hands on Bane's steroid apparatus, Joker uses it to bulk up to monstrous proportions. As Joker toys with the city with his superhuman strength, The Batman and Batgirl must find a way to defeat this unstoppable force.

videos.title: The Laughing Cats
videos.overview: When a pair of leopards is stolen by Joker, The Batman and Batgirl form an uneasy alliance with Catwoman, who is determined to save the rare animals from being hunted.

videos.title: Fleurs du Mal
videos.overview: Batman investigates why high ranking Gotham politicians have abandoned plans for a new hospital in favor of preserving the city's green areas. It soon becomes clear they are under the influence of Poison Ivy.

videos.title: Cash For Toys
videos.overview: When Wayne Industries shuts down Cosmo Krank, a toymaker with a spotty safety record, the demented villain takes revenge by trying to shut down Bruce Wayne – permanently – with his diabolical toys.

videos.title: The Apprentice
videos.overview: Jealous that Batman has a new sidekick, the Joker decides to recruit a youthful prankster to become his apprentice and partner in crime.

videos.title: Thunder
videos.overview: Maximillian Zeus, a millionaire who is also a Greek history fanatic, takes control of Gotham from the sky after losing to Mayor Grange in an election.

videos.title: The Icy Depths
videos.overview: The Penguin, Mr. Freeze, and Alfred's old school chum search for a rare umbrella that is the key to a valuable treasure in Gotham Harbor.

videos.title: Gotham's Ultimate Criminal Mastermind
videos.overview: Hugo Strange creates a AI database called D.A.V.E. (Digitally Advanced Villain Emulator), encoded with the minds of Gotham's greatest criminals, in order to better predict their crimes. However, DAVE breaks free and proclaims himself to be "Gotham's ultimate criminal mastermind".

videos.title: A Matter of Family
videos.overview: After a young circus performer named Dick Grayson loses his parents to a criminal named Tony Zucco, Bruce Wayne adopts the young boy and, as Batman, tries to help him capture the crime boss who is responsible for killing his family.

videos.title: Team Penguin
videos.overview: After watching a movie about criminal masterminds, Penguin assembles an all-star team of Gotham's most dangerous villains to take down Batman. Meanwhile, Batgirl and Robin try to work together for the first time.

videos.title: Clayfaces
videos.overview: Clayface turns himself over to the police, promising to give up his criminal past and prove himself to Batman. And the arrival of a new villain might be the perfect opportunity to redeem himself.

videos.title: The Everywhere Man
videos.overview: When evidence from a series of art thefts by the Everywhere Man, a new costumed villain with the power to replicate, implicates Bruce's close friend John Marlowe, Batman believes there must be another explanation. Now, Batman must unmask the identity of the "Everywhere Man" and prove his friend's innocence.

videos.title: The Breakout
videos.overview: After Batman apprehends Black Mask, his henchmen plan to spring him from Gotham P.D. so that Black Mask can activate his doomsday device. When Batman is captured, Batgirl and Robin must stop the villain on their own.

videos.title: Strange New World
videos.overview: Hugo Strange infects the population of Gotham City with a deadly toxin that transforms everyone into zombies. Uninfected, Batman and Robin must race against time to find and distribute the antidote before the change becomes permanent.

videos.title: Artifacts
videos.overview: A thousand years into the future, the citizens of new Gotham City are terrorized by a dangerous villain from the past. They must uncover the history of the Batman in order to defend themselves without him.

videos.title: Seconds
videos.overview: After a seemingly ordinary criminal continues to get the better of Batman and his partners it is discovered that he has the ability to travel back in time by several seconds. Batman is now faced with the seemingly impossible task of stopping a foe that knows his every move before even Batman himself does.

videos.title: Riddler's Revenge
videos.overview: The Riddler and Batman are dropped at the bottom of Gotham Harbor where he discovers what role he played in the origin of the villainous Riddler. Batman must find a way to save them both from certain death.

videos.title: Two of a Kind
videos.overview: After Batman takes down Punch and Judy, Joker takes an interest in the TV pop psychologist Harleen Quinzell and decides to groom her to become his new partner in crime, Harley Quinn.

videos.title: Rumors
videos.overview: The villains of Gotham City are disappearing, each one defeated and captured by an invisible vigilante named Rumor. Batman and Robin must defeat Rumor before he has a chance to execute the villains.

videos.title: The Joining (1)
videos.overview: John Jones, a new officer in Gotham, claims to know the true identity of Batman. Batman must learn whether the officer is an ally or not. Meanwhile, Wayne Industries is distributing alien technology across the world.

videos.title: The Joining (2)
videos.overview: Martian Manhunter's prediction of an alien invasion by The Joining has come true. After failing to save the city on his own, the Batman learns that even the greatest heroes have to sometimes rely on help.

videos.title: The Batman/Superman Story (1)
videos.overview: Batman and Superman find themselves teamed up when Lex Luthor begins his operations in Gotham City to take down his arch-nemesis, employing a horde of the Batman's villains to do so.

videos.title: The Batman/Superman Story (2)
videos.overview: Batman and Robin must battle Superman, who is under Lex Luthor's mind control, as the villain plans to launch a wave of robots and take over the world's armies.

videos.title: Vertigo
videos.overview: Batman welcomes another member of the Justice League to Gotham – Green Arrow. The two team up when Vertigo, a villain who can affect people's sense of balance, arrives in the city with a diabolical plan.

videos.title: White Heat
videos.overview: Firefly tries to upgrade his powers with the aid of his new girlfriend Blaze, but is exposed to radioactive phosphorous and takes on a new more dangerous identity as Phosphorus.

videos.title: A Mirror Darkly
videos.overview: Batman and Robin team up with the Flash to thwart Mirror Master's plans to trap everyone in their own mirror image.

videos.title: Joker Express
videos.overview: Gotham citizens are bursting into hysterical laughter and dumping stolen goods into the river, and Batman is soon on the trail of the Joker.

videos.title: Ring Toss
videos.overview: Nearing defeat by his arch-foe Sinestro, Green Lantern sends his power ring to fellow Justice Leaguer Batman. Unfortunately the ring is instead intercepted by the nefarious Penguin.

videos.title: The Metal Face of Comedy
videos.overview: A strange mishap causes the Joker's mind and personality to be downloaded into a computer, enabling him to control the new WayneTech Nanobots. This creates a new and improved body which attempts to destroy Batman, Robin, and the original Joker.

videos.title: Attack of the Terrible Trio
videos.overview: A trio of college misfits use stolen mutagens from Dr. Kirk Langstrom to transform themselves into animal forms and get revenge on those who have scorned them.

videos.title: The End of the Batman
videos.overview: The Batman meets his opposite in the form of Wrath and his partner Scorn who are helping Joker, Penguin, Killer Croc, and Ventriloquist and Scarface with a job. Batman and Robin must stop their evil counterparts.

videos.title: What Goes Up...
videos.overview: When Black Mask hires Hawkman's arch-nemesis the Shadow Thief to break him out of Arkham and assist in the theft of a meteorite, Batman must team up with fellow Justice League member Hawkman to defeat them.

videos.title: Lost Heroes (1)
videos.overview: When super-powered members of the Justice League begin disappearing one by one, Batman, Robin and Green Arrow must discover the mystery surrounding their disappearance.

videos.title: Lost Heroes (2)
videos.overview: The Joining attempts a second invasion of Earth with the stolen powers of the newly formed Justice League. Only the non-powered heroes Batman and Green Arrow remain to gain back their friends' powers and stand between the Joining and world conquest.
